title.rendered: Using nDPI to Turn Wireshark Into a Traffic Monitoring Tools

content.rendered:
Last week at Sharkfest EU we have shown how you can use nDPI and Lua scripting to turn Wireshark into a traffic monitoring tool.

We remind you that all the ntop contributions to Wireshark are open source and can be found on github.

Enjoy!
